name: codeandcanvas
description: Claude Code plugins by CodeAndCanvas728: SecuriKey keeps API keys and tokens out of Claude's context.

plugins.name: securikey
plugins.description: Keeps API keys and tokens out of Claude's context: secrets live in the OS keychain, commands get them by name through `skey run`, and hooks block any secret in a prompt or tool input and redact it from the output of calls that succeed or run through `skey run`.
